reviews.x: I really like Yes To products, but if you have sensitive/acne-prone skin you should be careful with this conditioner.  After using this conditioner for a few days I noticed that it was causing me to break out on my back and neck. I like everything else about the conditioner, it leaves my hair feeling really soft and protects my hair in the dry winter months. If you suffer from acne-prone skin, make sure you are using a cleanser after this conditioner to reduce the chance of forming a breakout.

Very dry where we live, high mountains, winter is nothing but static. For years I've used Nexxus Humectress conditioner for my fine, flyaway hair. I don't know why I decided to try something different. I guess because I like YES products. However, this conditioner weighs my hair down without really helping minimize static. When I brush my hair, it sticks to the sides of my face. I hate it when that happens. And because its a heavy conditioner, I feel like Ihave to wash my hair everyday. Somethin

I bought the shampoo and conditioner and like them both fine. I just feel like it weighs my hair down and can make it appear greasy if I'm not careful with how much I use. I do feel like it's made my hair softer, but I think I need something lighter. Good product, just not for me.
I used to use $50 Aveda, but I actually prefer this shampoo. Makes your hair so silky soft and leaves no itch whatsoever. Love the ingredients. My whole family uses.

I have never had a bad experience with Yes To products, and this one didn't disappoint.  I have short hair, and don't usually use conditioner.  As I get older, my hair has gotten very dry in the winter.  This set is amazing.  It softens my hair but the conditioner isn't so heavy that it weighs my hair down.

reviews.t: This is the one conditioner that makes my hair really soft and beautiful. No more dry
reviews.x: I get very dry skin and hair from competitive swimming. This is the one conditioner that makes my hair really soft and beautiful. No more dry, itchy scalp, either. I use TriSwim chlorine and salt removal shampoo then YesTo Coconuts conditioner with argan oil is the perfect moisturizing solution.

reviews.t: Yes To Coconut and Your hair will Thank You and look and feel absolutely amazing
reviews.x: I absolutely love this yes to coconut conditioner. I've been using natural products on my hair for years when I became tired of the harsh and dry hair from all the store brands. I will always buy yes to coconuts and highly recommend this to everyone. My hair is amazing and it's so soft and smells so good. Thank You Yes To Coconuts for making such amazing hair products!
I like the Yes To products and this is my favorite of the shampoos. I have thick, coarse, wavy to curly hair and this keeps my hair from frizzing up as much as it usually does.

reviews.t: I have fine hair, but a lot of it
reviews.x: I have fine hair, but a lot of it.  Unfortunately this conditioner just does not work if you need a strong conditioner.

I have been using Yesto products for some time now.  I am always on the lookout for chemical-free or as minimal chemical based products as I can get (also its extremely important to me to be cruelty free).  This shampoo/conditioner is just that and IT WORKS!  I love the coconut smell and it leave my hair clean and soft.  If you are looking for the things that I am in beauty products then this is a definite one to try.  Obviously not all products work the same on all body chemistry's but I believ

I have super thick, super dry hair. This is the only shampoo I have ever used that makes my hair feel softer after a shampoo (most of the time I need to have the conditioner on after for my hair to feel better).  This is my favorite shampoo by a long shot. That being said, I think that if you had fine hair, this would weigh your hair down a lot, but it is perfect for thick, dry hair! (I did not have as good luck with the conditioner of this brand though and use a different product for conditioni

I like the coconut smell. I have fine, thin hair and the Argan Oil weighs it down fast. I think it's best to put this on the middle section and ends if yours is fine and thin. I rinse really good to make sure it's not left in but I probably won't rebuy this because I need to find something that is made more for my type hair. Argan Oil is okay for people who have thicker and not so fine hair. It's a good product though.

Love this stuff! It’s very moisturizing and I love the smell. Smells like coconut but it also has a scent that remind me of herbs or fresh leaves. Very clean smelling. I also really like that it’s mostly natural. Very good product, especially for the price.  This might be heavy if you have hair that gets weighed down easily. For dry hair and/or out of control thick, wavy hair like mine, it is perfect.

reviews.t: As close to perfect as I have ever found
reviews.x: Coconut oil and argan oil, the two things I really wanted for the hot mess that is my hair (it's really dry and crunchy). Almost the perfect product. The fragrance could be a little nicer, more coconutty. Then again, that might attract bees 😅

reviews.t: Great for CG! Works better for me than the expensive conditioners
reviews.x: I love this stuff! I have wavy hair and was using really expensive conditioner, but this leaves my hair more moisturized and smoother and costs so much less. I use it as both a rinse out and a leave-in.

reviews.t: I like it, but I don't think it's meant for ...
reviews.x: I like it, but I don't think it's meant for daily use, just every once and a while.  My hair is getting sensitive to sulfates lately and while this has very little sulfates it still makes me shed.
I really like it! It’s hard to find soaps that don’t have stripping chemicals in them, they really destroy my hair and tear it up. This is affordable, smells lovely and doesn’t cause any buildup.
This product is true to their claim this works on your hair so much that you need not to use a straightening spray on your hair .. only a blow dryer!

reviews.t: Use this conditioner with the Curly Girl idea and love it. Works great and cleans my hair very ...
reviews.x: Use this conditioner with the Curly Girl idea and love it. Works great and cleans my hair very well. Smell isn't overbearing at all.
I love this shampoo. It's creamy and moisturizing. The coconut smells is lovely and not too strong.  Most of all, no toxins!
This conditioner does not rinse out of your hair well. Leaves an oily feeling. Love Yes products, not this one.

I absolutely love this product.  I noticed a difference the first time I tried it!  My hair has been very dry and brittle still a year after giving birth.  I've tried numerous products to try to get that lush mane that I had during pregnancy.  Nothing worked until this amazing shampoo!  My hair drinks this stuff up!  You can feel it absorbing it and it smells wonderful!  I just ordered the conditioner and can't wait to use the two together!

I love this shampoo and have been using it on my kinky-textures natural hair for years. It’s not stripping but cleans hair without drying. There was no safety seal over the opening of the bottle or any plastic wrapping on the outer cap. Not sure I’m comfortable using a product where I can’t even verify if it’s been tampered with it not. It was also leaking upon arrival

reviews.t: Smells so good! Breakout so bad :(
reviews.x: I really love the way this smells! It is truly like being transported onto a beach vacation. I struggle with sensitive skin and this causes mild breakouts on my face. If you don't have that issue, then you might really love this!

reviews.t: works and feels great on my scalp
reviews.x: I have really bad scalp issues, dry skin etc.  This product works great to help my scalp and hair feel fresh and moisturized.  It helps with most of the flakes, dry skin on my scalp.  I definitly recommend!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the conditioner very moisturizing and say it leaves hair soft and smooth.
Several reviewers with fine or thin hair say the product weighs their hair down or can make it look greasy.
Reviewers frequently praise the coconut scent and the mostly natural ingredients.
Some reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin report breakouts, and one notes it may not be strong enough for those needing a heavy conditioner.
Multiple reviewers say it works well for thick, dry, wavy, or curly hair and is a good value compared to expensive brands.
